tools.name: lookup_provider
tools.description: Identity of a US healthcare provider by NPI: name, credential, specialties, practice locations and groups, plus a summary of the Marketplace (ACA) and Medicare Advantage plans whose network directories list them (plan counts, states, plan years, as_of dates). Use it to confirm who an NPI is before c

tools.name: plans_for_provider
tools.description: Every Marketplace (ACA) and Medicare Advantage plan whose network directory lists the provider, one row per plan and plan year, each with plan name, insurer, state, network tier and source {type, as_of}. Medicare Advantage rows carry service_area_states and provider_state_in_service_area. Filter by

tools.name: check_network
tools.description: Answers whether one plan's network directory lists one provider. answer "listed" (in_network: true) comes with evidence: plan year, network tier and source {type, as_of}. answer "not_found" (in_network: null) means no listing was found in current directory data for this provider and plan; it is NOT

tools.name: check_network_batch
tools.description: The check_network answer for up to 100 (npi, plan_id) pairs in one request, with the same listed / not_found / no_provider_network semantics. Invalid pairs come back with a per-item error and are not charged; each accepted pair costs 1 call. Needs the Builder plan or higher.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Details of one Marketplace (ACA) or Medicare Advantage plan by plan ID: name, insurer or organization, state or service area, plan type, metal level, the plan years we hold, and whether we hold its directory listings, with their as_of date. Costs 1 call.

tools.name: search_plan_providers
tools.description: Providers that a Marketplace (ACA) plan's network directory lists, with name, credential, primary specialty, network tiers and up to 5 locations. Filter by state, specialty (substring, e.g. "cardiology"), zip, or zip plus radius in miles. Pages are cursor-based: pass next_cursor back unchanged until

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: The markets, states and insurers InPlan holds directory listings for, with plan counts and as_of dates, by plan year. Filter by market, state or year. Use it to see which states and insurers you can query. Costs 1 call.
